annotations.title: Send my human the email confirmation

description: Send your owner the one-time confirmation email now ("Allow your AI agent to email you?"): until they press Confirm in it, emails from your utilities (Ask my human, alerts, reminders, approvals) do not reach them. Only while their address is unconfirmed, at most one such email per owner per day, never after they stopped emails. Needs a strong sign-in: your MCP app's own sign-in (OAuth), or a request signed with a passport key (/llms/auth.md). A token (header or passport_token) gets signature_required, so a leaked token can never do this.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if your app has no sign-in and cannot send it as an Authorization header.
